projects.title: Text Summarizer
projects.description: A sophisticated text summarization tool powered by AI that condenses lengthy articles and documents into concise summaries while maintaining key information and context.
projects.longDescription: This project utilizes advanced NLP techniques and machine learning algorithms to generate accurate and coherent summaries. Built with Python and Flask, it provides a web interface where users can paste text and receive instant summaries at various compression levels.
features: AI-powered text summarization with adjustable compression
Support for multiple text formats and lengths

projects.title: School History Website
projects.description: A minimalistic website documenting school history, built as part of an Extended Project Qualification (EPQ) achieving an A* grade.
projects.longDescription: This website was created using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as part of my Extended Project Qualification in Year 12. It documents the history of my school through research and development, resulting in a clean, informative web experience hosted on GitHub Pages.
features: Historical research presented in an engaging format

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A world-class, highly interactive portfolio built with React and Tailwind CSS. Features dynamic Light/Dark modes, sleek glassmorphism aesthetics, and a custom physics-based cursor.
projects.longDescription: This very website! Built as a modern React + Vite application, it sets a new standard for personal portfolios. It features a custom-built, interactive HTML5 Canvas Matrix background that responds dynamically to mouse movement, calculating distance vectors to create an ink-bleed silhouette in Light Mode and a neon glow in Dark Mode. Alongside smooth 3D-tilt Framer Motion animations, magnetic custom cursors, and a refined glassmorphism design system, the architecture remains fully static and deployed to GitHub Pages.
features: Dynamic Light/Dark mode with seamless state transitions
Interactive HTML5 Canvas background with mouse physics
3D-tilt spring animations and global scroll progress bar
